$comment: Composition patterns of @oddkin/ai (component-architecture-audit.md section 7): recommended arrangements of existing elements, each with a working example and tests, and no element of its own. The agent kit lists them.

patterns.title: Suggested prompts
patterns.summary: Offer a few prompts the user can start from: buttons in a labelled group that fill the composer.

patterns.title: Branch navigation
patterns.summary: Move between versions of a message: previous and next buttons around the position.

patterns.title: Reasoning disclosure
patterns.summary: Show a model's reasoning on request, collapsed by default.

patterns.title: Copy action
patterns.summary: Offer copying for any AI output, from its canonical text or from an element on the page.

patterns.title: Empty conversation
patterns.summary: Tell people what they can do before the first message, with prompts to start from.

patterns.title: Chat layout
patterns.summary: A conversation, its composer, and a side panel for sources or artifacts that stacks on narrow screens.

patterns.title: Citations with sources
patterns.summary: Inline citation markers in a response, and the numbered list of sources they reveal.

patterns.title: Approval outside a tool call
patterns.summary: Ask for a decision on any action the application is about to take, on its own.
